text.body: || śrīḥ || śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpabādapraṇītasarvamūlagranthāḥ jayantīkalpaḥ|| śrīmaddhanumadbhimamādhvāntargatarāmakṛṣṇavedavyāsātmakaśrīlakṣmīhayagrīvāya namaḥ || rohiṇyāmardharātre tu yadā kālāṣṭamī bhavet | jayantī nāma sā proktā sarvāpāpapraṇāśanī || 1 || yasyāṃ jāto hariḥ sākṣānniśīte bhagavānajaḥ | tasmāttaddinamatyantaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ smṛtam || 2 || tasmāt sarvairupoṣyā sā jayantī nāma vai sadā | dvijātibhirviśeṣeṇa tadbhaktaiśca viśeṣataḥ || 3 || yo bhuṅkte taddine mohātpūyaśoṇitamatti saḥ | tasmādupavaset puṇyaṃ taddinaṃ śraddhyā'nvitaḥ || 4 || kṛtvā śaucaṃ yathānyāyaṃ snānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ | prabhātakāle medhāvī yogāyeti yathāvidhi || 5 || nityāhnikaṃ prakurvīta gavantamanusmaran | yogāya yogapataye yogeśvarāya yogasambhavāya śrīgovindāya namo namaḥ || 6 || madhyāhnakāle ca punaḥ sāyaṃkāle tvatandritaḥ | snāyīta pūrvamantreṇa vāsudevamanusmaran || 7 || tataḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ | yajñāyeti ca mantreṇa śraddhābhaktiyutaḥ pumān || 8 || kṛṣṇaṃ ca balabhadraṃ ca vasudevaṃ ca devakīm | nandagopaṃ yaśodāṃ ca subhadrāṃ tatra pūjayet | ardhyaṃ datvā sapabhyarcyābhyudite śaśimaṇḍale || 9 || jātaḥ kaṃsavadhārthāya bhūbharottāraṇāya ca | kauravāṇāṃ vināśāya daityānāṃ nidhanāya ca || 10 || pāṇḍavānāṃ hitārthāya dharmasaṃsthāpanāya ca | gṛhaṇārdhyaṃ mayā dattaṃ devakyā sahito hare || 11 || śrīrodārṇavasambhūta atrinetrasamudbhava | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rohiṇamayā sahitaḥ śaśin || 12 || datvā'rghyaṃ maninā'neni hyupasthāya vidhuṃ budhaḥ | śaśine candradevāya somadevāya cendave || 13 || mṛgiṇe śaśibimbāya lokadīpāya dīpine | rohiṇīsaktacittāya tārakāpataye namaḥ || 14 || upasaṃhṛtya tatsarvaṃ brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ | viśvāyeti ca mantreṇa tataḥ svāpaṃ samācaret || 15 || tato nityāhnikaṃ kṛtvā śaktito dīyatāṃ dhanam | sarvāyeti ca mantreṇa tataḥ pāraṇamācaret | dharmāyeti tataḥ svastho mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 16 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracito jayantīkalpaḥ samāptaḥ || || iti jayantīkalpaḥ || || śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
